name: tests

# Every pull request, and every push to main.
#
# Merging is gated on both jobs below passing on the pull request's last commit, and on the
# branch being up to date with main first, so the tree that lands is the tree that passed. The
# run on main therefore confirms what landed rather than catching it, and it is kept for one
# reason: it is the only run that exercises a change to this workflow as main will use it.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

# A new push to a branch makes the previous run's answer stale.
concurrency:
  group: tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    # Branch protection requires "test on ubuntu-latest" and "test on macos-latest" by name.
    # Renaming this job, or changing the matrix, leaves protection waiting for a check that no
    # longer reports, which blocks every pull request until the required checks are updated.
    name: test on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      # Both platforms report their own answer rather than the first failure ending the run.
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # The dense scorer loads a different native binary on each, and falls back to the Java
        # scorer where none loads, so each platform exercises a different path.
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Bazel downloads its own toolchain and every Maven artifact, which is most of the run.
      # Both caches are keyed on the lock file, so they are reused until a dependency changes.
      - name: Restore the build caches
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/bazel-disk
            ~/.cache/bazel-repository
          key: bazel-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ hashFiles('MODULE.bazel.lock', '.bazelversion') }}
          restore-keys: bazel-${{ matrix.os }}-

      - name: Test
        run: |
          bazel test //:test_main \
            --disk_cache="$HOME/.cache/bazel-disk" \
            --repository_cache="$HOME/.cache/bazel-repository" \
            --test_output=errors

      # The runner reports success when no test runs at all, so the count is asserted rather
      # than the exit status alone.
      - name: Assert that tests ran
        run: |
          log=bazel-testlogs/test_main/test.log
          if [ ! -f "$log" ]; then
            echo "No test log at $log."
            exit 1
          fi
          numTests=$(grep -oE '[0-9]+ tests successful' "$log" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+' | tail -1)
          echo "$numTests tests successful"
          if [ -z "$numTests" ] || [ "$numTests" -lt 1 ]; then
            echo "The suite reported success without running any test."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload the test log
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-log-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: bazel-testlogs/test_main/test.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  gradle-test:
    name: gradle test on ubuntu-latest
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v4.7.0
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@9c971963bec38e04b3d30dcc455b5382be2fdbfb # v4.4.0
        with:
          cache-disabled: true

      - name: Test with Gradle
        run: ./gradlew test --no-daemon
